provenance.paper_title: Mirage-1: Augmenting and Updating GUI Agent with Hierarchical Multimodal Skills

evidence.paraphrase: Execution skills retain multimodal historical trajectories and step goals.
Trajectories are progressively abstracted into core skills and meta-skills for planning.

Historical trajectories are progressively abstracted into reusable skill levels. For Mirage-1, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of multimodal execution-skill trajectories.
Execution, core, and meta skills form a consolidated hierarchy. For Mirage-1, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of multimodal execution-skill trajectories.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (multimodal execution-skill trajectories) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
